initialPresets.title: SnorriCam Adrenaline Lock
initialPresets.description: Chest-mounted rigid camera rig that locks onto the protagonist while the background rushes past in kinetic blur.
initialPresets.promptTemplate: SnorriCam body-mounted camera locked on retro-futuristic vehicle racing through a misty alpine pass at dawn, 24mm wide lens, intense motion blur, anamorphic tungsten flare.

initialPresets.title: Vertigo Contrazoom (Zolly)
initialPresets.description: Simultaneous camera dolly-out and telephoto zoom-in that warps spatial perspective around a stationary subject.
initialPresets.promptTemplate: Cinematic motion picture still of an astronaut exploring a brutalist concrete conservatory overgrown with glowing flora, golden sunbeams slicing through mist, Panavision aesthetic.

initialPresets.title: Nano Banana Architectural Twilight
initialPresets.description: Ultra-crisp 4K architectural rendering of minimalist glass basalt cliffside residence over stormy ocean waves at twilight.
initialPresets.promptTemplate: Ultra-modern minimalist glass and black basalt cliffside architecture overlooking stormy Scandinavian ocean waves at twilight, warm ambient interior architectural lighting, 8k photography.

initialPresets.title: Laowa 24mm Probe Macro Mechanical
initialPresets.description: Extreme bug-eye tubular macro lens gliding effortlessly through floating golden watch escapement gears and kinetic brass clockwork.
initialPresets.promptTemplate: Extreme macro probe lens shot gliding through intricate floating golden watch escapement gears, brass wheels and kinetic mechanical clockwork, studio rim lighting.

initialPresets.title: Medium Format Chiaroscuro Editorial
initialPresets.description: Medium format fashion portrait with subtle iridescent jewelry, natural skin pores, dramatic chiaroscuro window lighting, Kodak Vision3 500T grain.
initialPresets.promptTemplate: Medium format editorial fashion portrait of a model with subtle high-fashion iridescent jewelry, natural skin pores, dramatic chiaroscuro window lighting, Vogue cover quality, 35mm film grain.

initialPresets.title: Buchla & Brass Trailer Pulse
initialPresets.description: Sub-bass analog synthesizer pulse layered with low brass swells and taut polyrhythmic percussion.
